literal_meaning: চাল ও চিঁড়ে বেঁধে নিয়ে যাওয়া (bundling rice and flattened rice and departing)
figurative_meaning_en: To set off for a distant place with all necessary provisions packed
example_sentences_in_bangla: চাল-চিঁড়ে বেঁধে সকালেই রওয়ানা হয়ে গেল।
বন্ধুরা চাল-চিঁড়ে বেঁধে পাহাড়ে ঘুরতে গেল।
example_sentences_in_english: He packed his rice and flattened rice and left at dawn.
The friends bundled their provisions and set off for the hills.
note: This idiom reflects traditional Bengali rural practices of preparing simple staple foods like rice and chira for long journeys.
